title: area_trigger
summary: MSUI now implements both current Benilla area-trigger wires: CMSG_AREATRIGGER is the bare u32 DBC id, and SMSG_AREA_TRIGGER_MESSAGE consumes the redundant u32 length plus full cstring and surfaces the refusal through the ordinary UI error lane.

openItems.text: CMSG_AREATRIGGER: no builder/sender anywhere (client never reports entering a trigger volume)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: Added opcode 0x00B4 plus deterministic bare-u32 builder and WorldSession/NetworkClient sender.

openItems.text: SMSG_AREA_TRIGGER_MESSAGE: no handler (server refusal text such as level gates is dropped)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: Added opcode 0x02B8, exact length-plus-cstring parser, network dispatch, logging, and visible UI error feedback.

openItems.text: Deterministic packet and source-wiring checks pass; needs a live refused entrance to verify the server text and UI error presentation.
